# Known-bad npm packages — append-only list scanned by sca.yml.
# Format: `<package>@<version>  # advisory reference`
#
# Sources to mirror:
# - CERT/CC VU#534320 (Shai-Hulud npm compromise, Sep 2025)
#   https://www.kb.cert.org/vuls/id/534320
# - CISA Apr-2026 Axios npm advisory
#   https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/04/20/supply-chain-compromise-impacts-axios-node-package-manager
# - Wiz / Snyk / GitHub Security Lab community feeds
#
# When adding entries, link to the advisory in the trailing comment.
# Remove only after the registry has yanked the version AND we've
# bumped past it in our lockfile.
